name: Lineup HUD
author: Matchframe
licence: MIT (code, Matchframe; weapon icons, Lexogrine); fonts: SIL OFL 1.1
description: Broadcast HUD with all ten players in a row along the bottom: series and event panel, a score bar that turns into the round winner's banner, bomb bar, sponsor slot, killfeed, the observed player (team economy in freeze time) and radar.

ctColor.label: CT colour
ctColor.description: Colour of the team on CT, unless the team has its own colour.

tColor.label: T colour
tColor.description: Colour of the team on T, unless the team has its own colour.

eventTitle.label: Title above the series
eventTitle.description: Shown in the title line at the top left; the event's name when empty.

sponsorText.label: Sponsor slot text
sponsorText.description: Shown in the sponsor slot at the top right when no sponsor is scheduled for the scoreboard slot or top bar.

showObserved.label: Observed player
showObserved.description: The observed player's panel between the two teams' cards.

showSeries.label: Series panel
showSeries.description: The series maps under the title line.

showMoney.label: Player money
showMoney.description: Money on the player cards, the observed player and the team money in freeze time.
